description: This PHP class defines a filter field used in generating reports, specifically for filtering by an employee's joined date. It extends a base FilterField class, uses traits for date-time helpers, and constructs query expressions based on specified operators (less than, greater than, between) to modify a QueryBuilderWrapper object.

classes.name: JoinedDate
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employees based on their join date, with methods to add appropriate 'where' clauses to a query builder, supporting operators like less than, greater than, and between.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and adds date comparison expressions to the query builder based on the selected operator and date values.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in query expressions, in this case ['employee'].
